records.title: Exploiting Aerobic Fitness to Reduce Risk of Hypobaric Decompression Sickness
records.locator: Poster Abstract, Methods, Table I and Figures 1–2, PDF p. 1

model_extraction.predictor: Peak VO2 as aerobic fitness from treadmill or cycle testing
model_extraction.association_method: Univariate maximum-likelihood logistic regression as reported in Methods. Figure captions also use linear regression wording.
model_extraction.scope_note: The group classes differ in mean pressure, duration and ambulation. Exposure and participant linkage within or between classes are unavailable. VGE counts, onset-time denominators and delayed surveillance are not reported.

observations.locator: Poster Abstract and Table I, PDF p. 1
observations.note: Table I gives 15.2%, and Figure 1 gives 15.1% for the same 25/165. Individual exposure schedules and participant links are unavailable.
observations.protocol: NASA hypobaric archive exposures with resting or no oxygen prebreathe. Reported mean exposure pressure 6.5 psia and mean duration 180 min. About 75% ambulated at altitude.
observations.outcome_window: During the reported experimental exposures. Fixed observation and delayed follow-up are unavailable.

observations.locator: Poster Abstract and Table I, PDF p. 1
observations.note: Figure 2 attributes 165 exposures to PRP and seven to other NASA records. The author case count is for the complete class. Individual exposure schedules and participant links are unavailable.
observations.protocol: NASA hypobaric archive exposures with exercise during part of oxygen prebreathe. Reported mean pressure 4.3 psia and mean duration 240 min. The authors report no ambulation at altitude.
observations.outcome_window: During the reported experimental exposures. Fixed observation and delayed follow-up are unavailable.

note: Only observed DCS group counts and the poster's descriptive summaries and coefficients were extracted. The model examples and fitted curves do not supply observations.
